summary: The compliance review of the product 'GoldNow: Digital Top-up on Existing Gold Loans' identified several findings against the reviewed RBI rules. The feature complies with DLD2025:9(i) as it correctly directs disbursement to the borrower's bank account and repayment to the RE's bank account. However, there is a high-risk non-compliance with DLD2025:11(ii) as the feature only mentions the names of nodal grievance officers without their contact details. Medium-risk findings include non-compliance with KFS2024:4 regarding the explanation and acknowledgment of the KFS contents, and DLD2025:6(iii) for not providing a link to the KFS for each RE in the digital loan offers.
